page.notes: The scan is cropped at the right edge, so line ends are cut off (for example "ad" and "hu-" and "Col-" lines). The word "PRO" at the lower right is cut off by the edge and may continue as PRO-something. Some words at the line ends, such as "adesse" and "tranquillita-", are partly hidden by the edge of the page. Several lines are reconstructed from partly visible letters.
